title: PR #226: [DRAFT] Consolidate canonical SHA-bound organization census gate — conventional history
content:
State: open
Merged: False
Draft: False

## Purpose

Non-destructive replacement for PR #224 to remediate its V-16 Conventional Commits failure without rewriting or force-pushing the original branch. This branch is the active integration target for the engineering-evidence handoff. PR #221 and #224 remain open pending a human decision on supersession.

## Canonical census baseline

- Base / merge-base: `c9699e468d2291b7d1b18cc4e9db41acba99b80c`.
- Original census baseline was verified at `51f84238dfafb726360c05839ba31f635e3d81a9`; its prior green runs apply only to that SHA.
- Integration changes below modify the tree. All prior checks are historical evidence and must not be reused as verification of the current head.

## Engineering evidence handoff — 2026-10-23

- Added `catalog/schema/atc-build-evidence-handoff.schema.json` for `atc.build-evidence/v1`.
- Added `catalog/scripts/validate_engineering_handoff.py`: fail-closed schema, event identity, digest-shape, expected-SHA and canonical census HEAD binding. A stale source SHA blocks.
- Added regression tests for stale SHA, source/checkout mismatch, missing/invalid digest, incorrect event semantics, and schema compliance.
- Added `docs/architecture/ATC-ENGINEERING-EVIDENCE-HANDOFF-001.md`.
- Added `.github/workflows/consume-engineering-evidence.yml` with manual inputs for the independently inspected source run ID and expected SHA. It accepts only a successful `push` run on `atc-engineering/main`, downloads the named artifact, compares the ZIP digest to GitHub's artifact digest, checks `SHA256SUMS`, independently checks binary/report hashes, and binds the manifest to this repository's census.
- The consumer requires `ATC_FLEET_READ_TOKEN` with read access to `atc-engineering`; missing token/access fails closed.
- The census gate now runs when the handoff workflow or contract document changes.

## Source-side implementation

- `atc-engineering` PR #33 adds `scripts/validate_ecosystem_handoff.py`, regression tests, and an engineering CI step that validates manifest identity and uploaded binary/report integrity.
- PR #33 head: `2c5e6e33c07e9e42c277caff98f659f672cbbb3d`.
- PR-event run [#39976331710](https://github.com/A-TownChain-Okosystems/atc-engineering/actions/runs/39976331710) passed both `verify` and `Engineering self-test`; its tested checkout was merge-ref SHA `e713bd93dcab5f6a09706986ca354cd3d9ffdd35`, while the PR head was `2c5e6e33c07e9e42c277caff98f659f672cbbb3d`.
- Artifact ZIP digest: `sha256:ba432d5660140df6658b8dcd6bbb3fcd220aacfcc47a7582ff89b5f1a0817ca9`. The ZIP was downloaded and all eight `SHA256SUMS` entries independently matched.
- **This PR-event artifact is not accepted as exact-head push evidence.** A successful push run on `refs/heads/main` at the independently inspected expected SHA is required for the cross-repository consumer.

## Current acceptance state

- Current PR #226 head: `fa023423f283b9819c32dcf448c495b22a7156a7`.
- The integration commits invalidate the previously green baseline. An intermediate run at `9dfabb784b4ee08c97d4abc979ca348c88edaf21` exposed three test assertions that expected pre-schema-validator error text; the assertions were updated to accept the schema-first fail-closed messages. Current-head CI for `fa023423f283b9819c32dcf448c495b22a7156a7` has been queued (including Canonical organization census gate run [#39977137490](https://github.com/A-TownChain-Okosystems/a-townchain-ecosystem/actions/runs/39977137490) and File Catalog run [#39977137485](https://github.com/A-TownChain-Okosystems/a-townchain-ecosystem/actions/runs/39977137485)); inspect terminal job/step results before status promotion.
- The census still needs to be refreshed to the exact `atc-engineering/main` SHA after source-side changes land; until the manifest SHA matches the census head, the handoff must remain `BLOCKED`.
- Structural/schema validity does not imply functional verification. No merge or release is authorized by this change; keep Draft pending exact-head CI, evidence review, and human decision on superseding #221/#224.
